run_turk_combined_pipeline: run the full MTurk annotation pipeline for tool combined by scheduling HITs, collecting results, and collating data
run_turk_pipeline_dev_mode: run the MTurk combined tool pipeline in dev mode by passing the --dev flag as an argument
construct_turk_input_csv: construct a CSV input file from newline-separated commands using construct_input_for_turk.py with tool number 6
create_turk_hit_jobs: create MTurk HIT jobs from a CSV input file using an XML template and job spec CSV
collate_turk_results: collate MTurk output data with input job specs and postprocess results into a final CSV
